Description: Items gained through Clue Scrolls are unlocked.

Name: Mercantile Mastery
Description: Unlocks the ability to trade players and on the Grand Exchange.

Name: Death’s Mercy
Description: Untradeable Items are not lost on Death.

Name: Insatiable Greed
Description: Coins are not lost on Death.

Name: Meager Offering
Description: Unlocks Bones;Bat Bones;Wolf Bones;and Big Bones.

Name: Artisan’s Touch
Description: Items obtained through Skilling are unlocked. This does not include Monster Drops from combat.

Name: Bloodlust
Description: Items obtained from low level (1-40) Monster Drops are unlocked.

Name: Primal Hunger
Description: Items obtained from max level (500-10;000) Monster Drops are unlocked.

Name: Inversion of Fate
Description: Once;you may choose two of your unlocked item cards. Lock them;then unlock an item card in the current area’s Booster Pack

Name: Tome of Expertise
Description: Unlock a Skill card of your choice for as long as you own Tome of Expertise.

Name: Anthology of Proficiency
Description: Unlock two Skill cards of your choice for as long as you own Anthology of Proficiency.

Name: Chalice of Worlds
Description: You may destroy Chalice of Worlds and another Relic to unlock any Land card permanently. You may only use Chalice of Worlds once per run.

Name: Spellbound Map
Description: Unlock a Land card of your choice for as long as you own Spellbound Map.

Name: Entranced Scroll
Description: Unlock two Land cards of your choice for as long as you own Entranced Scroll.

Name: Infinite Hour Glass
Description: Choose a completed Combat or Skilling task: it is treated as uncompleted, then destroy this Relic. (You may do the task again for the Booster Pack reward).

Name: Tablet of Replication
Description: When you complete your NEXT task, destroy this relic and double the Booster Pack reward.

Name: Pillar of Commerce
Description: Unlocks the ability to trade players and on the Grand Exchange.

Name: Opus of Wisdom
Description: Grants access to the OSRS Wiki.

Name: Enchanted Harp
Description: Each unlocked music track now rewards a booster pack.

Name: Opal Idol

Name: Jade Idol
Description: On Death;you may destroy this Relic;then pick up to 5 Items to keep.

Name: Sapphire Idol
Description: On Death;you may destroy this Relic;then pick up to 7 in any combination of Relics and Items to keep.

Name: Emerald Idol
Description: On Death;you may destroy this Relic;then pick up to 10 in any combination of Relics and Items to keep.

Name: Ruby Idol
Description: On Death;you may destroy this Relic;then pick up to 15 in any combination of Relics and Items to keep.

Name: Topaz Idol
Description: On Death;you may destroy this Relic;then pick up to 25 in any combination of Relics and Items to keep.

Name: Diamond Idol
Description: On Death;you may destroy this Relic;then pick up to 50 in any combination of Relics and Items to keep.

Name: Dragonstone Idol
Description: On Death;you may destroy this Relic;then pick up to 100 in any combination of Relics and Items to keep.

Name: Onyx Idol
Description: On Death;you may destroy this Relic to pick and keep half of all other Items and Relics. You can only own one Onyx Idol.

Name: Zenyte Idol
Description: On Death;you may destroy this Relic to keep all other Items and Relics. You can only own one Zenyte Idol.

Description: All Killing Tasks grant an extra Booster Pack.
